review.advisory_review: All 67 exact package versions returned complete empty results from OSV querybatch and no PyPI advisory entries on 2026-09-27. This is point-in-time evidence; the current checker must run before installation.
review.artifact_review: Every selected wheel downloaded into memory, SHA-256 matched to authoritative PyPI metadata, complete RECORD hashes checked, paths inspected; no package code executed or archive extracted.
review.framework_choice: The official fastmcp-slim[server] extra has the same dependency closure as client+server apart from the omitted fastmcp metadata-only package. Required keyring support cannot be omitted without violating upstream dependencies.
review.lifecycle_review: Wheel-only installation; no sdists, .pth files, sitecustomize/usercustomize modules or .data/scripts members in selected wheels. Console entry points exist but are not installation hooks.
limits: No third-party runtime execution occurred during this static review.
Linux wheel/marker compatibility does not establish Linux runtime qualification.
Seven package families contain native binaries; manifest/RECORD checks do not constitute a native-code security proof.
OSV and PyPI coverage is incomplete; empty advisory results do not prove absence of vulnerabilities.
Python 3.11, macOS Intel, Windows, musl/Alpine and other targets have no reviewed lock profile.
review.portable_caio_selection: All profiles select the official caio 0.12.4 pure-Python wheel. Its source falls back to python_aio when optional native backends are absent, avoiding the macOS 26-only CPython 3.14 binary wheel; package version and declared dependencies are unchanged.
review.provenance_review: Canonical registry metadata, declared source ownership and available registry-served provenance subjects reviewed. Missing attestations are explicit; no Sigstore signature verification or reproducible source-build claim.
review.runtime_features: FastMCP imports Settings with cwd .env by default; the adapter must set FASTMCP_ENV_FILE to the null device before import, force telemetry off, and avoid credential stores, OAuth, HTTP transports, proxies and filesystem caches.
review.scope: Optional fixed-worker stdio adapter; core Hobnail remains free of third-party dependencies.
